item_name: Rothco Kids MultiCam Operator Tactical Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco's ball cap style tactical operator hat features durable polyester/ ripstop material designed just like the adult version.
description: Rothco's ball cap style tactical operator hat features durable polyester/ ripstop material designed just like the Adult version. Rothco's MultiCam Operator Hat for kids features enhanced tactical elements, including a loop patch on the top for an IR marker, loop area on the front of the cap ideal for flag, unit, or morale patch (are sold separately), and oop area on the back of the cap. The children's tactical operator cap is excellent for Airsoft players.
